def_en: A display screen that is thin and lightweight, commonly used on modern desktop workstations.
example_en: A flat panel monitor is thinner and lighter than an old CRT monitor.
example_es: Un monitor de pantalla plana es más fino y ligero que un monitor CRT antiguo.

def_en: An old, heavy monitor with a large tube inside.
example_en: The company still uses an outdated CRT monitor in the storage room.
example_es: La empresa todavía usa un monitor CRT obsoleto en el almacén.

def_en: A hardware unit that allows a laptop computer to easily connect to multiple desktop peripherals and power.
example_en: The docking station connects the laptop to several peripherals.
example_es: La base de conexión conecta el portátil a varios periféricos.

def_en: A keyboard designed to be comfortable during long working hours.
example_en: Staff use ergonomic keyboards to work comfortably during long hours.
example_es: El personal usa teclados ergonómicos para trabajar cómodo durante muchas horas.

def_en: A mouse that uses a light sensor instead of a rubber ball.
example_en: An optical mouse does not need a rubber ball inside.
example_es: Un ratón óptico no necesita una bola de goma en su interior.

def_en: The place on the wall where you plug in a power cable.
example_en: He checks every power socket to prevent system failure.
example_es: Revisa cada toma de corriente para prevenir fallos del sistema.

def_en: A cable that connects a device to a network.
example_en: He replaces the faulty network cable.
example_es: Sustituye el cable de red defectuoso.

def_en: Radio waves that carry data without cables.
example_en: Wireless signals are weaker behind thick walls.
example_es: Las señales inalámbricas son más débiles detrás de paredes gruesas.

def_en: A program or device used to find out what is wrong with a computer.
example_en: He uses a diagnostic tool to test the hard drive.
example_es: Usa una herramienta de diagnóstico para probar el disco duro.

es: puesto de trabajo / estación de trabajo
def_en: A desk with a computer where an employee works.
example_en: Every workstation in the office has a desktop computer.
example_es: Cada puesto de trabajo de la oficina tiene un ordenador de sobremesa.

def_en: A machine that copies paper documents into digital files.
example_en: The scanner converts paper documents into digital files.
example_es: El escáner convierte documentos en papel en archivos digitales.

def_en: A device that shows images on a wall or screen.
example_en: The projector shows the presentation on the wall.
example_es: El proyector muestra la presentación en la pared.

def_en: A powerful computer that stores files and offers services to other computers.
example_en: The server stores files for all the employees.
example_es: El servidor guarda los archivos de todos los empleados.

def_en: A problem caused by a broken physical part of the computer.
example_en: A hardware failure can stop the whole network.
example_es: Un fallo de hardware puede detener toda la red.

def_en: The main chip that carries out the instructions of a computer.
example_en: The processor is the brain of the computer.
example_es: El procesador es el cerebro del ordenador.

def_en: The main circuit board that connects all the parts of a computer.
example_en: Align the motherboard with the screw holes before you fix it.
example_es: Alinea la placa base con los agujeros de los tornillos antes de fijarla.

def_en: Temporary memory that the computer uses while it is working.
example_en: This laptop has 16 GB of RAM.
example_es: Este portátil tiene 16 GB de RAM.

def_en: A storage device with spinning disks that keeps your files.
example_en: A hard disk drive is slower than an SSD.
example_es: Un disco duro es más lento que un SSD.

def_en: A very fast storage device with no moving parts.
example_en: An SSD is faster and quieter than a hard disk drive.
example_es: Un SSD es más rápido y silencioso que un disco duro.

def_en: The part that gives electric power to the computer components.
example_en: Slide the power supply unit into its slot.
example_es: Desliza la fuente de alimentación en su ranura.

def_en: A card that produces the images shown on the screen.
example_en: The graphics card is the most expensive part of this PC.
example_es: La tarjeta gráfica es la pieza más cara de este PC.

def_en: The metal or plastic box that holds the computer parts.
example_en: Remove the side panel of the case.
example_es: Quita el panel lateral de la caja.

def_en: A device that blows air to keep the components cool.
example_en: The cooling fan is making a loud noise.
example_es: El ventilador hace mucho ruido.

def_en: A metal part that takes heat away from the processor.
example_en: Fix the heat sink on top of the processor.
example_es: Fija el disipador de calor encima del procesador.

def_en: A place on the motherboard where you add a card.
example_en: Insert the card into the expansion slot.
example_es: Inserta la tarjeta en la ranura de expansión.

def_en: A socket on a computer where you connect a cable or device.
example_en: This laptop has two USB ports.
example_es: Este portátil tiene dos puertos USB.

def_en: A small computer that you can carry with you.
example_en: She works on a laptop on the train.
example_es: Ella trabaja con un portátil en el tren.

def_en: A computer that stays on a desk and uses a separate monitor.
example_en: Most offices use desktop computers.
example_es: La mayoría de las oficinas usan ordenadores de sobremesa.

def_en: A machine that prints documents on paper.
example_en: The printer is out of paper.
example_es: La impresora se ha quedado sin papel.

def_en: A small camera used for video calls.
example_en: Check your webcam before the meeting.
example_es: Comprueba tu cámara web antes de la reunión.

def_en: Headphones with a microphone, used to talk on the phone or online.
example_en: The technician wears a headset all day.
example_es: El técnico lleva auriculares con micrófono todo el día.

def_en: A storage device outside the computer that you connect with a cable.
example_en: Save a copy of your files on an external hard drive.
example_es: Guarda una copia de tus archivos en un disco duro externo.

def_en: A small device for carrying files that you plug into a USB port.
example_en: I keep my CV on a flash drive.
example_es: Guardo mi CV en una memoria USB.

def_en: The part that stores power so a laptop works without a socket.
example_en: The battery lasts about eight hours.
example_es: La batería dura unas ocho horas.

def_en: A device that gives power to a battery.
example_en: I forgot my charger at home.
example_es: Me he dejado el cargador en casa.

def_en: A tool used to turn screws.
example_en: You need a small screwdriver to open the case.
example_es: Necesitas un destornillador pequeño para abrir la caja.

def_en: A gray paste that helps move heat from the processor to the heat sink.
example_en: Put a little thermal paste on the processor.
example_es: Pon un poco de pasta térmica en el procesador.

def_en: A band you wear to avoid damaging parts with static electricity.
example_en: Wear an antistatic wrist strap when you touch the motherboard.
example_es: Ponte una pulsera antiestática cuando toques la placa base.

def_en: A device connected to a computer, such as a mouse or a printer.
example_en: A printer is a common peripheral.
example_es: Una impresora es un periférico habitual.

def_en: A screen that you control by touching it.
example_en: Many tablets have a touchscreen.
example_es: Muchas tabletas tienen pantalla táctil.

def_en: A device that records your voice.
example_en: The microphone does not work in the video call.
example_es: El micrófono no funciona en la videollamada.

def_en: A small card used to store photos and files.
example_en: The camera uses a memory card.
example_es: La cámara usa una tarjeta de memoria.
